paper_title: Sound of Dark Matter: Searching for Light Scalars with Resonant-Mass Detectors
notes: Paper proposes resonant-mass detectors (Cu-Si sphere, AURIGA recast, DUAL, quartz) to search for scalar DM moduli coupling to both electron mass (d_me) and electromagnetic field (d_e). The exclusion/projection plot (Fig.1) shows both d_me and d_e on the y-axis vs mass mphi over 1e-22 to ~1e-4 eV. It constrains both ScalarElectron (d_me) and ScalarPhoton (d_e); pre-analysis hint suggests ScalarElectron. No numerical (mass,coupling) table is provided in the text; results are only in figures, so no reliable data points could be extracted. Earth seismology gives |de+dme| < 2.5e-4 at fphi~8.1e-4 Hz (mphi~3.3e-18 eV); EP gives |dme|<1.05e-2, |de|<2.98e-4. Confidence reduced because two scalar coupling types are constrained and data are figure-only. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 1 shows multiple constraint curves for both d_e (ScalarPhoton/alpha) and d_me (ScalarElectron). The hint suggests ScalarElectron but the lowest-lying d_e curves (Dy d_e purple, EP d_e orange) actually constrain alpha variation (ScalarPhoton). Traced the lower envelope of the d_e excluded region: Dy d_e at low masses (~1e-20 to 1e-15 eV) dipping to ~3e-7, EP d_e flat at 2.98e-4 in the intermediate range, then rising at higher masses. Axis multipliers: log10 axes, converted from log10[m_phi/eV] and log10|d_i|.
